description:
The Zoom Video SDK UI Toolkit is a prebuilt library that provides a fully functional video session UI built on top of the Zoom Video SDK. It enables developers to quickly integrate a complete video conferencing experience into their applications with minimal effort, while still retaining the ability to customize the experience to suit their needs.

To know more, see: https://developers.zoom.us/docs/video-sdk/
